description: Header file defining the QpackOfflineDecoder class for testing QPACK decoding from files, including methods for decoding, verification, and error handling within the quic namespace.

classes.name: QpackOfflineDecoder
classes.description: A class for decoding and verifying QPACK-encoded data from files, used for testing interoperability.

methods.name: DecodeAndVerifyOfflineData
methods.description: Decodes encoded header blocks from input file and verifies against expected headers from another file.

methods.name: OnEncoderStreamError
methods.description: Handles encoder stream errors, as part of the EncoderStreamErrorDelegate interface.

methods.name: ParseInputFilename
methods.description: Parses decoder parameters from input filename.

methods.name: DecodeHeaderBlocksFromFile
methods.description: Reads and decodes header blocks from a file.

methods.name: VerifyDecodedHeaderLists
methods.description: Verifies decoded header lists against expected headers.

methods.name: ReadNextExpectedHeaderList
methods.description: Parses the next expected header list from data.

methods.name: CompareHeaderBlocks
methods.description: Compares two header lists, allowing for order differences.
